findings.source_quote:
How gleam thy watch-fires through the night
with never-fainting ray!
findings.suggested_fix:
Translate "watch-fires" as a form of watch/fires/beacons rather than "vakttorn" (watch-towers). For example: "Hur glimma vakternas eldar genom natten
med ett aldrig sviktande sken!" or "Hur glimma dina vaktseldar genom natten
med en aldrig sviktande stråle!" Preserve the two-line structure and the sense of light/beacons rather than towers.
findings.translation_quote:
Hur glimma dina vakttorn genom natten
med en aldrig sviktande stråle!

findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Swedish wording to the conventional phrase "daggrynningens ljus" or "daggryningens sken". For example: "för att möta daggrynningens ljus!"
Use a more idiomatic Swedish rendering of "drifting sands", for example "de drivande sandarna" or "de drivande sanddynerna". Suggested: "förgäves de drivande sandarna:"
